versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.4

- Enhanced documentation with in-depth usage instructions and parameter explanations in SKILL.md.
- Added clear criteria for when to use (or not use) the skill, with suggested user prompts and follow-up questions.
- Detailed the four core features: keyword search, note details, note comments, and creator content fetch.
- Provided extensive usage examples and typical workflow recipes for market research, competitor monitoring, and KOL selection.
- Improved clarity on input requirements, error handling, and integration scenarios for supported agent platforms.
